article.title: Effects of Zinc Supplementation on Glycemic Control, Insulin Resistance, Inflammation and Oxidative Stress in Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
article.authors: Loaiza-Giraldo JP, Amigo-Fierro F, Cancino-Castro CI
article.abstract: Diabetes mellitus (DM) is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance, impaired insulin secretion, and increased cardiometabolic and inflammatory burden. Zinc plays a key biological role in insulin synthesis, storage, signalling and antioxidant defence; however, the clinical relevance and consistency of zinc supplementation effects in diabetes remain uncertain.
